A_general.open_code_note: No official public repository or package was found in the evidence folder or the searched official documentation.
A_general.release_status: GA; Crossbeam states it became generally available on all plans September 1, 2026.

B_access_pricing.mcp_access_cost_details: MCP access is available on all plans at no separate access charge, but MCP usage consumes annual Crossbeam Credits. Baselines: Free 50, Connector 500, Supernode 2,500, Enterprise 5,000 credits per year. Supernode and Enterprise can purchase additional packs; Free and Connector cannot.
B_access_pricing.linked_software_cost: Official pricing page lists Free, Connector, Supernode, and Enterprise plans; displayed plan prices were not present in the collected page text.
B_access_pricing.pricing_model_details: Credits are shared across the organization, reset annually, and do not roll over. Extra packs are available to Supernode and Enterprise; the pricing page states $0.10 per credit. Credit enforcement began September 1, 2026. Some free capabilities, including own-account context and product knowledge, remain available when credits run out.
B_access_pricing.other_access_restrictions: A qualifying Full Access or Sales seat is required. Access to records follows the authenticated Crossbeam user's permissions. Some client integrations require an administrator to enable the connection. Free plan pagination and some AI features have limitations.
B_access_pricing.restrictions_controlled_by: Crossbeam controls plan entitlements, credits, and account permissions; organization administrators control supported client-side connector setup; the connected user authenticates their own account.

C_capabilities.description_what_how: Hosted Streamable HTTP MCP exposes a documented list of 11 read-only tools. The official technical reference documents tool purposes, parameters, example calls, and response patterns.
C_capabilities.post_interaction_context_structure: Documented responses include structured data, pagination, and status/error cases such as clarification_required, invalid_input, and retry_later. The exact wire format of every response was not independently observed.

C_capabilities.description_what_how: No product-server resource listing or resource documentation was found.
Documentation says tools work together through prompts but does not establish that the server implements the MCP prompts capability.
No MCP-specific server logging or audit behavior was documented. Product plans separately describe workspace audit logs.
No server-side sampling capability was documented.

The input endpoint returned HTTP 401 and a Bearer challenge pointing to protected-resource metadata. The supplied metadata advertises header bearer tokens, authorization server https://mcp.crossbeam.com, and scopes email, offline_access, openid, profile. Authorization metadata advertises DCR, code flow, PKCE methods S256 and plain, authorization_code, refresh_token, and JWT bearer grant types, with client_secret_basic token authentication.
C_capabilities.authorization_mechanism: Metadata Doc; Dynamic Client Registration; OAuth authorization code and refresh token, plus urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:jwt-bearer. PKCE S256 and plain. token_endpoint_auth_methods_supported: client_secret_basic. scopes_supported: email, offline_access, openid, profile. bearer_methods_supported: header. Token lifetime and revocation details were not present in the supplied metadata.

C_capabilities.description_what_how: No MCP elicitation mechanism was documented. Tool descriptions instruct clients to present ambiguous matches for clarification, but documentation does not show server-initiated elicitation.
C_capabilities.post_interaction_context_structure: Ambiguous input may return clarification_required with candidate matches.

C_capabilities.description_what_how: A tool may return retry_later for large reports that are still computing; no MCP Tasks capability is documented.
C_capabilities.post_interaction_context_structure: The documented retry_later response includes retry_after_seconds.

Official tool references document structured clarification_required and invalid_input cases, and retry_later for background-computed reports.
C_capabilities.post_interaction_context_structure: Documented status values and fields include unresolved input fields and candidate matches, invalid-input messages, and retry cadence.

C_capabilities.description_what_how: No MCP subscription capability was documented.
Documentation describes retrying delayed reports but does not document MCP progress notifications.
C_capabilities.post_interaction_context_structure: retry_after_seconds is documented for retry_later responses.

C_capabilities.description_what_how: The official reference describes Streamable HTTP transport and OAuth 2.1 with Dynamic Client Registration. Tool responses can include pagination, clarification results, or delayed-report retry instructions.
C_capabilities.post_interaction_context_structure: The technical reference includes response examples and a changelog.

D_server_side_logic.additional_logic: 1. All 11 officially documented tools are described as read-only; no MCP tool annotations were found in published material. 2. No enforced confirmation flow is documented; no write tools are documented. 3. OAuth metadata advertises the scopes email, offline_access, openid, profile. Crossbeam says access follows the authenticated user's permissions. Client admins may control connector setup; token lifetime and revocation specifics were not found. 4. No endpoint-level toolset, read-only toggle, or sandbox mode was found. Claude and Gong documentation describes client-side tool toggles; these are client controls. 5. Returned data is limited by account permissions and partner sharing; some contact context is returned only when sharing is enabled. No MCP-specific masking policy was found. 6. Annual shared credits meter AI access; limits, free-plan pagination and result truncation are documented in selected tool descriptions. 7. Tool descriptions document fuzzy matching, ID precedence, clarification results, and pagination constraints. No server implementation code was available to inspect coercion or unknown-argument handling. 8. Audit Logs are a product-plan feature; MCP-specific action logging and telemetry were not documented. 9. No feedback/rating/report tool appears in the official list or Claude directory listing. Credits documentation includes upgrade prompts when Free/Connector accounts exhaust limits. 10. Tool descriptions carry routing, clarification, pagination, and response-handling instructions; no server-delivered skill tool was found. 11. Memory effects were not documented. 12. One hosted endpoint is documented; no sub-server structure was found. 13. No raw API, arbitrary SQL, or script execution tool was listed.
behavioural_instructions_to_ai_verbatim: Prefer get_partner_context for comparing partners across your whole book rather than against a single account.
Always pass the user's exact wording in name fields — let the tool fuzzy-match. Do not substitute IDs from memory.
If pagination.has_more is true, tell the user how many more results exist and ask before fetching the next page.
D_server_side_logic.server_structure_explanation: A single documented hosted endpoint exposes a flat set of tools. No dynamically loaded toolsets or server hierarchy was documented.

E_aggregated.token_method: The hosted server is closed and the official materials do not reproduce a complete initialize response and exact tools/list payload in a serializable form.
E_aggregated.human_can_agent_cannot: Crossbeam users can create or modify records, share lists, manage partners and permissions, and administer integrations in the product, but the documented MCP toolset is read-only. The MCP tools generate a shareable list URL, but do not themselves create, edit, or delete records. Sources: https://www.crossbeam.com/pricing ; https://developers.mcp.crossbeam.com/

F_documentation.implementation_hints_not_enforced: Tool descriptions recommend routing questions to specific tools, using exact user wording for fuzzy matching, presenting candidate matches for clarification, and asking before fetching subsequent pages in specified cases. These are instructions to the client/agent; no public server code was available to establish enforcement.
F_documentation.governance_promises: Crossbeam states that the authenticated user sees data they are permitted to access and that shared contact context depends on partner sharing. The AI/data-use article discusses Crossbeam AI and data handling but does not establish MCP-specific retention or training behavior in the collected evidence.
F_documentation.promises_to_user: Crossbeam describes MCP as secure, structured access to ecosystem data and states that all documented tools are read-only. The server uses OAuth rather than API keys.
F_documentation.comparison_with_server_logic: The read-only promise matches the published tool list, which contains no documented write or destructive tools. Permission inheritance and partner-sharing limits are described by Crossbeam, but closed server code prevents independent verification of their implementation. Agent-behavior instructions are in tool documentation; server enforcement is not established.

contradictions: The official technical reference lists get_list_link. The Claude connector directory instead lists get_overlap_list_link, get_ecosystem_list_link, and get_deal_navigator_close_deals_link, and does not show get_list_link. The additional catalogue names are recorded as third-party in actions.json; the difference may reflect different tool versions.

OAuth metadata advertises email, offline_access, openid, and profile, while the tool documentation describes record access as inheriting the user's Crossbeam permissions. The advertised scopes are identity/authentication scopes and do not enumerate product-data permissions.
observations_for_research: The published tool descriptions shape agent routing and interaction behavior with recommendations for tool selection, fuzzy matching, clarification, pagination, and when to ask before retrieving more results.
Usage is metered through a shared annual organizational credit pool; Free and Connector users cannot buy additional packs, while some free capabilities remain available after credits run out.
notes: Checked links.json, links_check.txt, pages/ including official docs and script-rendered article content, and code/GITHUB_COMMITS.txt. No official repository or package was identified. The provided endpoint evidence and OAuth metadata were used without re-fetching. The endpoint itself returned 401. Third-party listings reviewed include Claude, Agent Discoverability, StackMCP, and MCP.so; the latter two do not provide a tool list. Pricing page text did not expose displayed plan prices. No additional official endpoint was found.
